item.title: Human-in-the-Loop, the Business-Comfort Zone, and Vigilance Theory
item.description: Human-in-the-Loop is sold as a quality guarantee for AI decisions. In practice it is a business-comfort zone – a place where a living person carries the responsibility for decisions they do not actually control.
